description: On the bed in front of you there’s a white AirPods charging case connected to a white charging cable. The left hand reaches in from the left and grips the case as a left-hand object while the right hand moves in from the right to pinch the cable plug, pulling it straight out to unplug it; the left hand then lifts and shifts the case leftward and sets it down, while the right hand holds the loose cable end as a right-hand object.
